description: This file implements an integer value refinement pass for the Torch JIT compiler, analyzing and optimizing integer comparisons and propagations within computational graphs.

classes.name: IntegerValueRefiner
classes.description: A class that performs value refinement analysis and optimization on a Torch JIT graph, focusing on integer comparisons and conditional branches.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the refinement pass on the associated graph, returning true if modifications were made.

methods.name: blockHasIntComparisons
methods.description: Checks if a given block contains integer comparison nodes.

methods.name: removeIfNodeOutputsWithRefinements
methods.description: Replaces outputs of an if-node with refined constant values when possible to optimize the graph.

methods.name: RefineIntegerValues
methods.description: Recursively refines integer values within a block based on comparison operations and propagates constants.

methods.name: tryFindRefinement
methods.description: Attempts to find a known refinement (constant value) for a given value.
